nowing Spirits, guardians of the unknown, knowers of knowledge, keepers of secrets, you whose vision and hearing
are mighty grant me thy wisdom and understanding. Listen to me and converse for I have need of thy insight.”
Description: As per Greater Communication but no limit to the number of questions asked and the spirits may
respond to an individual question with more than just seven words. Questions must be asked in a measured and
respectful manner, or no response will be gained. The caster may choose to have all questions be only regarding one
specific area, in which case the divination lasts 5 minutes, or simply answering any questions they desire, in which
case the duration is only two minutes but the miracle becomes far more versatile.
In order to acquire this miracle must first possess Communication and Greater Communication.

name: Spiritual Watching
description: todo

name: Steal Life Essence
description: todo

name: Storm of Power
description:
As Voice of Power but all within radius of up to two levels below the caster are affected (i.e. 6th level
characters are affected assuming the caster is 8th level). Releasing the miracle releases all targets simultaneously.
This miracle does not affect the undead.

name: Strengthen the Spirit
description:
The willing beneficiary gains the effects of Determination against non-magical stopping effects for the
duration; that is to say, any stopping effect targeted on the beneficiary for the duration has no effect but costs the
target 6 tblp to shrug it off. This is involuntary, and occurs even if the beneficiary was actually immune to the
effect! This miracle does not affect the undead.
~ 46 ~
 Light Of Purity
Level: 6sp
Alignment: Good
Sphere: Minor Dismissal
Duration: Instant
Range: 20’
Gesture: Point at target
Verbal: “Spirits of light blaze your glorious radiance upon this undead spirit and let it be consumed in your divine
brilliance... Light of Purity!”
Description: This miracle inflicts 12 spiritual hits on an undead, it has no effect on any other creature. On a Player
Character undead it inflicts 36pts of damage as per Spiritbolt. However Resistance to Spirit-Bolt does not apply,
although SAC does.
Destroy Gaseous Form
Level: Variable
Alignment: Good
Sphere: Major Dismissal
Duration:5 minutes
Range: 20’
Gesture: Point at target
Verbal: “By the power of the spirits of light I bid that you return to your true form!”
Description: This miracle costs spirits equal to the dismiss level of the target minus two (so 4 sp for use on a level 6
vampire) to cast. If the target is not undead it costs 6 spirits. This causes any one target which is benefiting from a
Vampiric Gaseous Form to return to their normal form and then be unable to turn Gaseous for the remainder of the
miracle’s duration. Immunity to Involuntary Shapeshifting grants immunity to this miracle’s effects.
This miracle costs 40pts to buy

name: Strengthen Ward
description:
May be cast on any Minor or Major Ward of Power that the priest has cast themselves. That Ward no
longer has a duration, but lasts until the caster releases it or it is assaulted with sufficient miracle attacks to destroy
it. However while the Ward remains, the spirits used on the Strengthen Ward miracle may not be regained.
This is not a releasable miracle, although releasing the ward upon which it was cast will end it automatically.
4th Level Neutral Advanced Miracles

name: Stronghold of Goodness
description:
This functions in all exactly as per a Protection from Spirits cast versus evil in every way except where
noted above and will act as a barrier to keep out any evil spirit regardless of level. The miracle stops if the casting
Priest leaves the area of effect. This miracle is releasable.

name: Stronghold of Hatred
description:
This miracle is identical to the miracle Protection From Good Spirits in every way except where noted
above and the fact that the barrier keeps out any good spirit regardless of level.
7th Level Evil Advanced Miracles
Wild Evil
Level: Variable*
Duration: Instant
Alignment: Evil
Sphere: Universal
Range:20' radius
Gesture: See below
Verbal: "Darkness feed on my essence and let all feel your touch!" to be shouted, followed by a declaration of the
damage inflicted (see below)
Description: As the verbal is incanted the caster must slash a body part with a dedicated ritual knife (which cannot
be used in normal combat - it is permissible to carry this blade), inflicting 6 points of damage to the location and
TBLP. The caster must be flesh-and-blood. The blood is then sucked from the wound by wild and hungry evil
spirits that cluster around the priest. These spirits form a dark and evil maelstrom centred on the priest which
inflicts 6/1 spiritual damage to all within the radius for each 2 spirits the priest releases, to a maximum of 12 spirits
and 36/6 damage to all. SAC applies against this damage as normal, except for the casting priest, who cannot in any
way shield against the attentions of the spirits, and must take the full damage. Should this miracle be cast a second
time within an hour, the casting priest loses all remaining spirits to the uncontrolled evil spirits drawn to the bloodshed, including his own - thus dying. Damage from this second casting is still limited to 36/6 however.
This miracle affects the undead, but may not be cast by them (as they have no blood).
*This miracle costs 50pts to buy
~ 67 ~
 Pact of Blood
Level: 7th (8sp)
Alignment: Evil
Duration: 15 minutes
Sphere: Universal
Range: Touch
Gesture: Touch with both hands
Verbal: “Black spirits watch this one, and let the blood-shed he/she causes free thee to act as ye will."
Description: This miracle ‘hangs’ on the hands of the caster for 30 seconds, in the same manner as causing
miracles. While under the effect of this miracle each time the target draws the blood of a spiritual target (hits a
flesh-and-blood creature with a sharp weapon for the first time) they are struck by the drawn evil spirits, taking 36/6
evil spiritual damage to which SAC applies (12 Hits to monsters). This damage is taken each time a new flesh-andblood target is struck after the miracle becomes active, but once taken from a given creature there is no further
penalty for striking that creature again. This miracle does not affect the undead.

name: Stronghold Of Neutrality
description:
This miracle is identical to the miracle Protection From Spirits except that it functions only against
neutral spirits and will keep out any neutral spirit regardless of level. If cast by a neutral spirit user they will be
unhindered by the miracle and able to cross it themselves.
~ 57 ~
 8th Level Neutral Advanced Miracles

name: Summon Barrow-Wight
description:
The miracle must be incanted over a corpse within a Protection from Good Spirits. This corpse need
not be fresh, and in fact is often an ancient body within a tomb. At the incanting of the final words a dagger must be
driven into the chest of the corpse, and from the wound the Barrow-Wight will arise. Barrow-Wights are shadowy,
ethereal creatures called to guard the sanctity of an area. They are fully intelligent and may walk through walls at
will in the same fashion as a wraith (suffering a 2-second disorientation on leaving). They have 25 supernatural hits,
and inflict Purely Spiritual 9pt Double by unarmed blow. This does mean that magic hurts them, and for example an
elf with a magic weapon could kill them while they could not harm it. Additionally their touch causes 2 points of
permanent damage to the touched location (not tblp). This is an undead touch-effect, and no AC or damage
reductions apply to it (having half a spirit means that only 1 point of perm is inflicted). This damage can only be
cured by exposing the wounds to the rays of the next dawn (normally, lasts till end of adventure). Barrow-Wights
are level 6 undead. A barrow-Wight will not willingly leave the area in which it was summoned, which may be a
specific building if summoned within one, or a roughly 60' area otherwise. Even if controlled they will refuse to do
so. They are banished whence they came by sunlight, and fear it terribly.
~ 70 ~
 Summon Wraith-Warrior
Level: 7th (8sp)
Alignment: Evil
Duration: 30 minutes
Sphere: Major Necromancy
Range: 3'
Gesture: As Summon Wraith
Verbal: "By all the powers of darkness, spirit of evil I summon thee forth! By the shades of the netherworld and
blood you have shed, wraith warrior I name thee! I call thee from the land of the spirits! By my powers I summon
thee here! Behold! By the power of my spirits thou art summoned here! Come forth!"
Description: In all ways as Summon Wraith (not Wight), except that the summoned undead arrives equipped with
dark and ethereal armour and sword. It now discerns as a Level 6 Wraith Warrior, has 16 spiritual Hits, and may
inflict purely spiritual damage by weapon type + one weapon mastery with its sword, which no other may wield. It
may also channel its powers of level-draining and fear through sword-blows.
8th Level Evil Advanced Miracles

name: Summon Haunt
description:
This miracle summons a non corporeal spirit which inflicts Fear (as the miracle) by each touch at will.
It is slain by a total of 12 spirit only hits. The Haunt has a Dismiss / Control level of 4 and is controlled by its
summoner only for the first 5 minutes of its existence. The Haunt’s general outlook on life is that it likes to be scary,
and should be given due respect, it is an intelligent undead. It may walk through walls at will, in the same fashion as
a wraith.

name: Summon Rod of Power
description:
Summons a purely spiritual 'O' class rod into the caster's hands. This weapon is +1 spiritual, and can
only be wielded by the caster. It may not be thrown. The caster may call the weapon back to his hands at will with
the phrase 'Rod to me!'. Strength may not be used with this weapon unless the appropriate tables ability is bought.
This is a releasable miracle, and affects the undead.

name: Summon Wraith-Warrior
description: todo

name: Sunder Spirit
description:
The effect of this miracle is as per Spirit Bolt but it inflicts 72 tblp [24HTK]. Resistances to Spirit Bolt
and SAC apply as normal.

name: Taint of Blood
description:
Should the target shed the blood of a spiritual being after this miracle is cast (use a sharp weapon
against a flesh-and-blood target) evil spirits are drawn to cluster around them. As such, for the rest of the miracle's
duration the target cannot benefit from goodly miracles and is considered 'Evil' for all disbeneficial spiritual
purposes (e.g. crossing Protections). Additionally they will be unable to use goodly spiritual powers unless they
possess Divine Guidance. An effect which repels Evil spirits will remove the miracle from a target unless they are
themselves spiritually Evil.

name: Taint Spirit
description: todo

name: The Black Death
description:
This acts as per the Cause Disease miracle, but begins at the 5 minute stage and progresses rapidly.
Reaching the 10 minute stage after 1 minute, the 30 minute stage after 3, and death occurs at 5 minutes.
People that have multi-raced Mummy may learn this as a minor causing miracle.
~ 73 ~
 Treare’s Harm
Level: 8th (12sp)
Alignment: Evil
Sphere: Major Causing
Duration: Instant
Range: Touch
Gesture: Touch target
Verbal: “Spirits of Darkness and Suffering answer my call! I summon you here to bring my foes low. Spirit feel now
the anguish as they life suffers mortal….. Harm!”
Description: Must be able to cast Touch of Death, and be on table 10. This miracle hangs for 30 seconds as with
most causing miracles. When touched it causes the target to suffer causing equal to their starting tblp. SAC applies
at 6 points for every point of SAC the target has. Resistances to causing then apply. This miracle costs the caster a
level to cast (reductions can be purchased as per level loss from Touch of Death). It does not affect the undead.

name: The Empress' Sacrifice
description: todo

name: The Light Of Faith
description:
Upon completion of the miracle all undead which are not permitted to enter daylight are feared and
must leave the area immediately. Any other undead who enter suffer 4 spiritual hits, or 12 tblp to Player Character
undead, this only affects them the first time they enter the area. No undead may spiritually Shift into or within the
area for the duration of the miracle. If the caster leaves the area of effect for any reason then the miracle is cancelled.

name: The Touch of the Forge
description:
Causes the chosen weapon to become +0 spirit for the duration. Additionally it counts as Master
Status, making it immune to Shatter, Warp, Disintegrate, Melt, Magnetise, Vanish, and all similar effects.

Cost: 40pts
This ability causes the Spiritual Warrior to count as a 0 spirits per level priest allowing them to use and benefit
normally from Spirits and Extra Levels of Spirits acquired. Becomes fully restricted to sharp weapons as per normal
priest.
Utilise Shield
Available To: Armoured Priest
Cost: 30pts
Grants the priest the ability to use a Shield of any allowed size.

Available To: ALL
Cost: 30pts
Character only losses ½ level when casting Animate Life, Restore Life, Touch of Death, or similar miracles. This
must be purchased once for each miracle (e.g. an evil priest could buy it for Touch of Death and Animate Life).
1/3 Level Loss “Miracle”
Available To: ALL
Cost: +30pts
From 1/2 level loss: Now only losses 1/3rd of a level when casting Animate Life Restore Life, or Touch of Death.
Undead Visage
Available To: Evil Priest
Cost: 50pts
Discerns as a particular standard undead at all times (even if not) if the character is actually undead this ability
cannot be used.
Ranged Discerns
Available To: ALL
Cost: 10pts*
Bought per discern this increases the standard priestly discerns to Line of Sight but not Recognise Spirit or Discern
Nature of Wounds.

Available To: ALL
Cost: 20pts
Discern Nature of Wounds Range increased to 20’.
First Extra Level of Spirits
Available To: ALL
Cost: 40pts
Grants the priest an extra level of spirits, with a minimum however of 4 (i.e. pure priests gain 5, hospitallers 6 all
other classes 4). Note that if it is a character without spirit points normally, these spirits can only be used on making
scrolls and items, not on adventure (however see Spiritual Choice below). Shamans count as Pure Priests for the
calculation of spirits from Extra Level of Spirits
~ 87 ~
 Second Extra level of Spirits
Available To:
Cost: +45pts

spirits total.
Discern Associated Spirits
Available To: ALL

Reveals to the priest the number of associated spirits they have remaining.
Discern Poison
Available To: ALL
Cost: 30pts
Reveals to the priest if there is poison within a target with a spirit.
Remember Unknown Undead Type
Available To: ALL
Cost: 30pts
Allows the priest to remember ‘unknown’ undead types, at a basic level this will reveal all published undead, and
other undead names are revealed if the priest has previously discovered the name, they may wish to keep a list to
help.
Minority Spheres
Available To: Any
Cost: 50pts
Rather than taking a major Sphere in a single tree may instead gain all minor Spheres and a maximum of 1
published major Sphere miracle from each standard Sphere. Miracle must still be appropriate to casters alignment.
Witch – Spirits
Available To: 1st Class Witch
Cost: 40pts
This ability grants the Witch a base of 4 spirits per level
however may no longer use the Cudgel – becomes a non-weapon using priest.
Words of the Gods
Available To: Any
Cost: 40pts
Allows the priest to slightly change their verbals to call upon their deity or patron. The miracle must still be obvious
and close to the published verbal.
Gauge Spirit

As Recognise Spirit but also reveals spirit size (see Spirit of Seeing miracle for definitions) and number of spirits
present within Range. Still has 1” Range.

Make Healing Balm

 Spiritual Facility 1

Spiritual Choice
Available To: Spirit Warriors and Wayfinders only
Cost: 60pts
Extra levels of spirits purchased can be assigned to miracle innates at the beginning of each adventure, of miracles
on the character’s miracle list only. Once all three extra levels of spirits are bought may begin each adventure with
12 spirits of miracle innates chosen at that time. This also applies to spirits gained from other sources (e.g. Bound
Spirits or similar).
Change Priestly Class
Available To: ALL 1st-class bar Witches, Friars, Shamans,
Grey Wardens & Guardians of the Balance. *
Cost: 60pts
This changes the character’s class one step along the path of pure->armoured->warrior->battle->crusading->spirit
warrior, in either direction. For example, a Spirit Warrior could become a Crusading priest through one purchase of
this ability. It should be noted that all abilities are now as the new class, and any abilities previously purchased
which are not available to the new class can no longer be used – the points are effectively wasted.
Defensive Technique
Available To: ALL Non-weapon wielding
Cost: 60pts
May now use a staff for the purpose of parrying only. May not inflict damage with this, but may buy Distancing
Combat related abilities for use in conjunction with this ability. This staff may be used to draw wardings such as
Protection from Spirits without penalty.
Table 3
[250pts Post 8th Level]
Immunity to ‘Spirits of Miracle’ of Own Alignment
Available To: ALL
Cost: 100pts
This ability means that the priest is not harmed/detrimentally affected by animate Spirits of Miracle of his own
alignment. For example, an Evil priest would be immune to the damage caused by a Spirit of Causing. This ability
refers only to animate Spirits of Miracle played by a monster, not to any other form of those miracles.
Resistance to Victim’s Revenge
Available To: ALL 1st Class
Cost: 40pts*
Gains half previous effect from Victim’s Revenge.
~ 90 ~
 Slayer
Available To: Evil Priest
Cost: 80pts
May permanently kill any already dead target in such a manner that a spiritual restore life will not work. Though a
mantic one would, but costs twice as much restore life chance. Has a range of touch and takes 10 seconds
concentration/ritual to use.
Neutrality to Lesser Undead
Available To: Evil Priest
Cost: 100pts
Grants neutrality to undead 5th level and below. Meaning they may not attack the priest and vice-versa.
Ward Knowledge
Available To: ALL
Cost: 40pts
Spiritual informational effect with a 1” Range. Will discern a Ward of Power or Protection from Spirits. Reveal if it
is a Minor or Major Ward of power, Protection from spirits, or other “Warding line” (Bar spirit etc.). Non-Standard
warding miracles are revealed at ref’s discretion.

Weapon Mastery Pure

Repel Undead

Greater Invoke Evil

Invoke Evil when cast inflicts 72/12 from 36/6.
~ 91 ~
 Devotion I
Available To: ALL 1st Class
Cost: 80pts
This ability allows the priest to specialise in one of the miracle ‘trees’ listed above. If they choose to do so, they
may not have any Major Sphere miracles other than those that fall within that Sphere – the only exception to this is
the control undead tree, which if chosen does not prevent the priest from acquiring a Sphere as normal. The priest
may buy one miracle from that tree at half-cost for each points threshold the priest has achieved – for example, with
Devotion: Healing a priest on table 8 could buy 8 Total Heal miracles for 30 points each, rather than 60.
May not possess Devotion II.
Devotion II
Available To: ALL 1st Class
Cost: 80pts
This ability allows the priest to specialise in one of the miracle ‘trees’ listed above. If they choose to do so, they
may not have any Major Sphere miracles other than those that fall within that Sphere – the only exception to this is
the control undead tree, which if chosen does not prevent the priest from acquiring a Sphere as normal. The priest
may buy one of each innate on the ‘tree’ at half-cost, for each points threshold achieved. However, the entire tree
must be bought once before any miracle on it can be bought again. For example, a priest on Table 8 with Devotion:
Healing could buy up to eight of every miracle from Cure Wound to Restore Life at half-cost, but would have to buy
one of each before he could buy a second of any, and so on. Asterisked miracles may be skipped on each time
round the tree or purchased as desired.
May not possess Devotion I.
Spirit Link
Available To: ALL
Cost: 80pts
The priest is aware of the death of any member of their priestly guild, the current location of the dead body and the
approximate circumstances of the death. This is a spiritual informational effect. During an adventure, the ref should
inform the character if a guild-member dies as soon as it happens. Off-adventure, the player must actively use this
ability by investigating whether a particular character is dead and asking the character’s player; alternatively, with
the guild-master’s permission it can become an open guild benefit and be listed in the Companion.
Summon Minor Angel
Available To: ALL Goodly
Cost: 150pts* (Max 3)
This allows the priest to call forth a minor angel of the same faith as the priest, which will aid the priest as best it can
for a short time. The Angel remains for 15 minutes or until slain, and has 12 spiritual Hits. It arrives with a purely
spiritual bastard sword with which it inflicts damage by weapon type. It sheds spiritual light in a 10’ radius around
it, and fears all Evil creatures of 3rd level and below on sight if desired. This includes intelligent undead such as
ghouls. The Angel can walk through non-spiritual walls at will, with a 2-second disorientation period on leaving a
wall as a Wraith has. It is incapable of performing anything the ref considers an Evil act. It has 12 Goodly spirits
which it can cast on any goodly miracle on the summoner’s guild miracle list, or they should they not belong to a
priest guild, on any ‘standard’ goodly miracle. Angels may also cast protection from spirits but only vs. Evil. They
have 8th level resistances, and see with active spirit-sight (only).
Embody Minor Angel
Available To: ALL Goodly
Cost: 200pts
This allows the priest to call a minor angel directly into him, transfiguring his form to become that of the angel. For
5 minutes, the user gains use of the angel’s 12 spirits, sheds spiritual light and fears Evil of up to 3rd level, and may
walk through walls, all as the Summon Minor Angel ability above. They become purely spiritual, suffering only
spiritual damage, for this duration, and see with spiritual sight. While so Embodied, they are vulnerable to an effect
such as Hand of Putrefaction that destroys angels.
~ 92 ~
 Summon Abishai
Available To: ALL Evil
Cost: 150pts* (Max 3)
This allows the priest to call forth a minor abishai of the same faith as the priest, which will aid the priest as best it
can for a short time. Abishai are dark, demonic angels of evil faiths, shadowy creatures with bat-wings. The Abishai
remains for 15 minutes or until slain, and has 12 spiritual Hits. It arrives with a purely spiritual bastard sword with
which it inflicts damage by weapon type. It fears all Goodly creatures of 3rd level and below on sight if desired.
The Abishai can walk through non-spiritual walls at will, with a 2-second disorientation period on leaving a wall as
a Wraith has, and can shadow shift once without verbal, from any point of dense shadow to any other point within
sight. It is incapable of performing anything the ref considers a Goodly act. It has 12 Evil spirits that it can cast on
any evil miracle on the summoner’s guild miracle list, or they should they not belong to a priest guild, on any
‘standard’ evil miracle. Abashai may also cast protection from spirits vs. good only. Should the abishai perform a
Touch of Death the summoner suffers the level-loss, not the angel. They have 8th level resistances, and see with
active spirit-sight (only). They are considered daemon-kind.
Embody Abishai
Available To: ALL Evil
Cost: 200pts
This allows the priest to call an abishai directly into him, transfiguring his form to become that of the creature. For
5 minutes, the user gains use of the abishai’s 12 spirits, fears Good of up to 3rd level, and may walk through walls,
all as the Summon Abishai ability above. They may shadow shift once. They become purely spiritual, suffering
only spiritual damage, for this duration, and see with spiritual sight. While so Embodied, they are vulnerable to an
effect that would destroy demons.
Summon Spirit Weapon
Available To: ALL
Cost: 150pts*
Summons a +1 purely spiritual one-handed weapon of choice, which lasts for one hour and can be used by anyone
capable of using neutral spirit items.
Summon Good / Evil Spirit Weapon
Available To: ALL Good / Evil
Cost: 150pts*
Summons a +0 purely spiritual one-handed weapon of choice, which is +2 versus spirits of the opposite alignment.
It lasts for one hour, and can be used by anyone capable of using good / evil spirit items.
Table 5
[450pts Post 8th Level]
Discern ‘Spirit of Miracle’

description:
This miracle returns the Priest to his temple across any distance or barrier including time, whilst
travelling the Priest is safe from any attack. It is impossible to prevent this miracle from working if it is successfully
cast by a priest with sufficient remaining spirits.
A Good or Evil version of this miracle is available also as a 8th (10sp) miracle.

name: Wound Staunch
description:
This miracle enables the caster to completely heal any tblp damage that the target has taken, if 30
seconds of calm preparation are spent with the recipient before casting (cf. Total Heal). This miracle does not cure
locational damage and on a creature with only half a spirit this miracle will not cure more than 72pts of damage. If
the miracle is not prepared for (see Total Heal), it cures only 72 tblp or 36 tblp for a creature with half a spirit. This
miracle does not affect the undead.

name: Wrath of the Lord
description:
This miracle may only ever be cast by the current High Priest of an existing church (with seven or
more members, etc) – even if bought while High Priest, should a character lose that status it may no longer be used.
Shaman may learn this miracle and apply it to the death of their tribe-members or attacks on them.
It may only be cast on a target who has either harmed the High Priest or slain a member of the guild within the last 5
minutes. The target suffers 48 tblp, 8 to every location, and is knocked to the ground and is unable to act for 30
seconds or until struck, regardless of level (This stunning effect is as per a non-level based stasis). Spiritual AC
applies at 6/1 per point to the damage but the only way to avoid being knocked to the ground is to have Resistance
to Wrath of the Lord or half a spirit.
Border

name: Writhe
description:
Causes the target to collapse in agony as per a spasm (immunity to spasm applies). Resistances to
causing reduce the time the miracle lasts by 15 seconds per resistance owned. If a resistance to causing is owned
then the effects of this miracle will break if the target suffers damage.
This miracle does effect the undead and is releasable.
4th Level Evil Advanced Miracles

name: Spiritual Freedom
description: This miracle enables the priest to remove a Spiritual Mastery miracle. It also removes Beguile and Befriend Spirit miracles and will remove any physical versions of the above.

name: Regeneration
description: This miracle enables a priest to regenerate a severed limb. On completion of the incantation, the limb will begin to grow and it will be fully usable after 5 minutes. This miracle only works on living targets. In the case of missing body-parts other than limbs, such as the eyes, the miracle's effects are generally deemed to be instant, at ref's discretion. This miracle does not affect the undead.

name: Reveal Truth
description: This miracle enables a priest to ask a spirit whether a statement he has heard recently has been the truth or a lie. The statement must have been made by a being with a spirit. The ref should inform the caster whether the speaker believed the statement or did not believe it (i.e. was lying). The actual truth of the statement does not matter, only the speaker's perception of it. Rather than repeating the statement, the priest may simply utter the verbal immediately after a statement – in this case the miracle affects the last statement heard, whatever that may have been. In a change from previous this now allows statements to be checked for a 5minute period. Each statement must be repeated or the verbal used after each one. Alternatively a single statement may be checked at any time after it has been heard. Differences/Additional rules: a Conceal Lie miracle does not work against it. For the duration of the miracle the priest recognises any and all lies spoken by someone with a spirit.

name: Total Heal
description: This miracle enables a priest to totally heal a character or monster of all damage, if both priest and recipient spend 30 seconds in calm preparation before the invocation, the priest praying to their patron and neither party in combat. If the miracle is cast without this preparation it cures only 72 tblp and 72 points of locational damage. This is an absolute system limit, and no ability under any circumstances circumvents this. Note that on creatures with half a spirit, like half-Elves, Total Heal only cures 72 points as above if prepared and only 36 points if unprepared. This miracle does not affect the undead.

name: Restore Life
description: This miracle allows a recently dead (up to 2 weeks of real time) character or monster to be brought back to life. The priest is drained of a level if this miracle is used successfully – immunity to level drain and similar abilities do not apply to this loss, as the miracle is cast voluntarily. The body should be placed in a circle of Protection from Spirits (evil) with a lit candle (or safe phys rep candle) at each shoulder and at each foot. If the miracle is successful, the person restored to life has 7 total body life points and 1 location life point at each location (even if they had suffered unhealable wounds that would prevent this). A monster, if resurrected, has 2 hits. If for any reason this miracle fails to work, then the priest still loses 10 spirits and 10 life points. If the person remains at rest within the general area (20ft) of where they were restored to life do not cast/engage in combat they will be completely healed 5 minutes later. name: Spirit of Seeing and Hearing
description: This miracle is very similar to the Spirit of Seeing miracle. It has all the effects of a Spirit of Seeing and can also read the surface thoughts of any spirits in the area and so tell their short-term intent. In general, non- animate spirits, such as those in items or active miracles, will not have thoughts!

name: Stasis
description: The effects of this miracle are as the Halt miracle in most ways except for Range and duration. The only other difference is that a touch is not sufficient to free the target of a Stasis – only actual damage will suffice.

name: Detect Lie
description: This miracle enables a priest to ask a spirit whether a statement he has heard recently has been the truth or a lie. The statement must have been made by a being with a spirit. The ref should inform the caster whether the speaker believed the statement or did not believe it (i.e. was lying). The actual truth of the statement does not matter, only the speaker's perception of it. Alternatively a single statement may be checked at any time after it has been heard.

name: Control Mummy
description: This miracle enables a priest to take over control of a spirit animating a zombie. If the level of the priest performing the miracle is higher or equal to the level of the priest currently controlling the zombie, then the miracle succeeds otherwise it fails. For control purposes, an uncontrolled zombie or a zombie under the control that is inherent in the Animate Zombie miracle, is considered to be controlled only by a Differences/Additional rules: one level 4 or below undead is affected.

name: Spiritual Invisibility
description: The caster's spirit cannot be perceived by any spirit and thus is immune to ALL spiritual effects. This includes all miracles. The caster cannot cast miracles or even use innate (spiritual) abilities, excepting that the priest may remove his own Spiritual Invisibility miracle. Spiritual Invisibility can only be cast on the caster. This miracle does not affect the undead.

name: Animate Zombie
description: This miracle enables a priest to summon spirits to enter dead bodies to create zombies. A priest can generally create zombies out of bodies that are up to 28 days old, or otherwise ruled by the ref to have remained fleshy. The priest is able to animate 4 hits + 1 hit per level of the priest in zombies and can spread this number of hits amongst the zombies in any combination he likes. e.g. A

name: Temporary Curse
description: This miracle enables a priest to curse a person for a limited period of time. The effect of this miracle is to spiritually slow the victim's reactions to the extent that the victim loses 2 points of dexterity AC, to a minimum of 0. If this miracle is cast on a monster then it reduces the monster's AC by 2 points alternatively if the monster is not set with AC it decreases the monsters remaining hits by four. The minimum hits a monster can be left with after being cursed is one, as clearly the miracle cannot kill but merely increase the amount of damage the victim receives during combat. This miracle is also known as 'Damn'. Alternatively, the miracle can be cast upon a target of Evil alignment beneficially, instead granting them 2 Dexterity AC in a manner similar to Temporary Bless. However in this case the miracle lasts only 5 minutes. Objects may also be cursed, and this functions as detailed under Temporary Bless. All priests of any alignment are able to cast a miracle of equivalent effect to Damn, as a final dying Damn, as long as they have at least 2 spirits remaining. The priest need not have this miracle on his guild miracle list though he must be at least second level. The dying priest always has enough time to utter the incantation before he expires providing he says it at the instant of death. The verbal for this curse is "With my dying breath I damn thee". This miracle if cast as a dying damn, is not removed by the involuntary Remove Own Miracle cast during the death trauma. The priest is deemed to spend the agony of his death trauma willing retribution on his slayer. This miracle cancels the effect of a Temporary Bless, though it has no effect on a full Bless.

name: Conceal Lie
description: This miracle enables a priest to counteract the effects of a Detect Lie miracle, or any other form of Lie Detection power used by someone with a spirit, such as neuronic Detect Lie. Clearly it could be used to withstand the inquisition of the Paladin ability to Detect Lie. However, blatant lies cannot be concealed and it must be cast before the false statements are made. The casting priest can always elect to allow a Detect Lie miracle to work on him at any time during this miracle's duration. These evil types can be really tricky!

name: Spiritual Mastery
description: This miracle enables the priest to summon a spirit to take control of a character or monster. Short of suicide, the victim will do the priest's bidding unhesitatingly and without question. A "controlled" priest loses the ability to use any good aligned miracles whilst "controlled". If a spiritually mastered character should increase in levels to parity with the level of the priest when he performed the spiritual mastery, the spiritual mastery still holds but the character may distort any of his master's instructions. Note that the target may still perform actions of their choice as long as these do not conflict with any orders given to them by their master. A person can only have one spiritual mastery spirit within his body at any one time. The latest spiritual mastery overrides any other, but if the previous master is of a higher level then his spiritual mastery holds. A priest may only have a number of victims up to his level of experience mastered at one time, and these should be recorded on the priest's character card. A person detects as being spiritually evil whilst spiritually mastered and has this additional spirit hovering around the body. This miracle only works on characters of less than the caster's level. It does not affect the undead.

name: Summon Wraith
description: This miracle enables a priest to summon a wraith (or wight) from the spirit plane. The ritual to summon a wraith is as follows. 1. Obtain the name of the wraith (any evil priest of suitable level can be assumed to have learnt some of these names as part of their training, so this simply requires a suitable in character name to be chosen). 2. Inscribe the name on a scroll of parchment. 3. Place the scroll within a circle of Protection from Goodly Spirits. 4. Utter the incantation while holding a ritual dagger. 5. Throw the dagger into the circle while repeating the 'By my powers...' section of the incantation. 6. The wraith will appear in the circle at the end of the incantation under the control of the summoner. name: Suspend Life
description: Once the priest has finished incanting the verbal, he has 30 seconds in which to touch the victim of the miracle with the open palms of both hands. If he does so, then the victim falls unconscious. This is a listed stopping effect. The victim is not dead and has a very faint pulse (only discern nature of wounds or similar will tell that the character is still alive). If he receives 5 points of spiritual curing to every location he can regain consciousness. This miracle just renders its victim unconscious, it does not do any damage. This miracle does not affect the undead.

name: Summon Vampire
description: This miracle enables a priest to summon a vampire from the spirit plane. The ritual to summon a vampire is as follows: 1) A vampire name must be used (see notes under Summon Wraith for comments on these) 2) Inscribe the name on a living human/humanoid "sacrifice" (this should be phys-repped but not necessarily made visible) 3) Place the sacrifice in a circle of Protection from Spirits (good), draw in chalk and then seal the circle from the outside. 4) Cast the incantation, the vampire spirit will appear 5 minutes after the end of the incantation. It will then enter the body of the sacrifice so slaying the sacrifice. The vampire so summoned is not in any way controlled by the priest and so must be persuaded to do any task the priest wishes done. A vampire is not to be trifled with; requests to bring in the milk etc. are unlikely to be greeted with delight. Remember it could still be there when your own protection runs out! N.B. A vampire cannot be summoned in daylight.

Information Concerning the Undead The term undead generally refers to creatures that have passed the stage of death and are somehow held in a state of continued existence, almost always by evil spiritual power. Physical undead use the corpse of a dead creature to hold the spirit, and the spirit moves the body even as it rots slowly away. Incorporeal undead are just spirits, called from the netherworld where they reside to the prime plane. There are many, many different sorts of undead, ranging from simple unintelligent spirits which can only follow basic commands right through to spirits which are at least as clever as the humans who may summon them, and can be truly powerful. Only seven sorts of undead are universally known of, and these are listed below – other sorts are less common and their natures may vary widely. Full undead all see with spirit sight, whether they also have physical eyesight as well or not. Their spirit sight is 'active', and allows them to see all spirits within the range of normal sight, as well as recognising alignment and seeing even through solid physical barriers to see spirits behind them. Fresher physical undead, or well-preserved ones, may also have physical eyes – without these, they will not be able to see creatures like elves or priests who have hidden their spirits. Even undead who have no means of transportation other than physical movement can be ordered to return to their own plane by a controlling priest, in which case their spirit immediately does so, leaving behind the body they may have had possession of. Zombie A zombie is a mindless, unintelligent undead. It can be animated from the body of a recently dead humanoid, man- sized creature. A body can generally be animated as a zombie up to 1 lunar month (28 days) after the original death of the body. A zombie can only inflict damage of Single with one handed weapons, or Double with a two handed weapon. Zombies move very slowly, generally described as 'half-speed', meaning that a competent and agile warrior should have little trouble besting one in combat. They have a dismiss level of 1. If a zombie moves more than 18' (6 paces) away from its point of animation it collapses lifeless, never to move again. Skeleton A skeleton is also an unintelligent undead. It can be animated from a well decayed body of a dead humanoid creature of man-size. It can wield weapons in the same way as zombies, albeit faster. Their resistance to sharp weapons and their ability to move at full speed makes them relatively dangerous opponents. They have a dismiss level of 2. If a skeleton moves more than 18' (6 paces) away from its point of animation it collapses lifeless, never to move again. Ghoul A ghoul is a semi-intelligent undead. It can be created from the body of a recently dead humanoid, man-sized creature. A body can be used in the creation of ghoul up to 2 weeks (14 days) after the original death of the body. They have an animal-like cunning, and an ability to think that parallels the most intelligent of wild beasts. They will sometimes hunt in packs, and often drag helpless victims off for later feeding. A ghoul cannot be created in daylight and when created, will never venture out into daylight. Unlike zombies, skeletons and mummies, ghouls eat flesh where possible. A ghoul eats dead humanoids and prefers to eat 1 man-sized body per week to survive. A ghoul will only venture from its place of creation if it is:  Controlled  Feeding  If its place of creation is outdoors A ghoul can paralyse its victims by merely striking them, the results in them being unable to move for 5 minutes. In addition its unarmed blows do Single. The paralysis is a spiritual effect. If a ghoul is able to feed regularly its body remains in relatively good repair, and they maintain their physical eyesight indefinitely. Ghouls have a dismiss level of 3. Mummy A mummy is a semi-intelligent undead. It can be created from a specially prepared body provided it is humanoid and man-sized. The embalming process generally means that mummies keep their physical eye-sight indefinitely. The special preparations are that the body must be embalmed, within 7 days of its death, in special embalming bandages and then a Cause Disease miracle must be cast upon the body some time before the Create Mummy miracle is to be cast. If Cause Disease is not cast upon the body then the mummy will not cause disease with touch. A mummy is not restricted to its point of creation and may venture into daylight. It can be summoned anywhere as long as it is not in bright light or daylight, which it will not willingly enter. A wraith does not cause damage but is able to drain levels by touch. Once summoned a wraith will not return to its plane unless:  It is dismissed  It is slain (it takes 8 spirit hits to destroy a wraith)  It has drained 6 levels  It has been controlled and ordered to return to its plane.  The miracle's duration expires, A wraith can also walk through walls and cause fear by touch, at will. When leaving a wall it suffers a two second disorientation period during which it cannot move and is invulnerable to damage, but can be targeted by non- damaging effects. A wraith cannot attack whilst any part of it is in a wall. The fear induced by a wraith causes the victim to run away from that wraith if that wraith can be seen, and is generally as per the Cause Fear miracle. Wight A wight is also an intelligent purely spiritual creature, except that its presence chills the spirit. Its touch freezes victims still for 5 minutes, alternatively it may inflict purely spiritual single by unarmed combat. It can "plane shift" between locations when reappearing it suffers a two second disorientation period during which it cannot move and cannot suffer damage (but could be effect by spiritual effects that do not damage it).
